quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_Schedule.description: Date schedule definition for payment and accrual dates.

end_of_month.description:
Presence-required: absent-vs-false silently changes schedule dates for
month-end-anchored (money-market) schedules.

first_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
firstDate, which controls the FIRST stub coupon: with Backward date
generation a first_date after effective_date creates a short/long first
period; with Forward generation it anchors the regular periods. Must lie
strictly between effective_date and termination_date. Omit for no first
stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

next_to_last_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
nextToLastDate, controlling the LAST stub coupon symmetrically to
first_date. Must lie strictly between effective_date and
termination_date (and, when first_date is also present, on or after it).
Omit for no last stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

quantra_Fixing.description: Historical index fixing for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexDef.description: Complete index definition. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

index_type.description:
IBOR or Overnight. Determines QuantLib class used. Presence-required: an
omitted value is a 400, never the silent Ibor default.

tenor.description: Tenor period (e.g., 6 Months for Euribor 6M, 0 Days for overnight).

fixing_days.description: Fixing days (e.g., 2 for Euribor, 0 for SOFR/ESTR). Presence-required.

end_of_month.description:
End of month rule (IBOR only, ignored for overnight). Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes money-market schedule dates.

fixings.description: Past fixings needed for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexRef.description: Reference to an IndexDef by its id.

quantra_CurveRef.description: Exogenous curve reference for multi-curve bootstrapping.

quantra_HelperDependencies.description: Exogenous curve dependencies for dual-curve bootstrapping.

discount_curve.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve bootstrapping.

projection_curve.description:
Exogenous projection/forwarding curve. Reserved for
TenorBasisSwapHelper (not implemented yet); rejected on SwapHelper,
OISHelper and DatedOISHelper, whose projection curve is always the
curve being bootstrapped. The FX helpers carry their own explicit
curve references instead.

rate.description: Deposit rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

quote_id.description: Optional: reference a shared quote by id instead of inline rate.

rate.description: FRA rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

Implied rate. Used when futures_price is absent. One of rate,
futures_price or quote_id must be provided.

futures_price.description: Futures price (e.g., 95.25); when present, rate is ignored.

convexity_adjustment.description: Convexity adjustment added to implied rate.

quantra_SwapHelper.description: Vanilla IBOR swap helper. Uses IndexRef to reference an IndexDef.

rate.description: Swap rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

float_index.description: Reference to an IndexDef by id (e.g., "EUR_6M").

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for multi-curve bootstrapping.

rate.description:
Bond quote as a rate-style value. Used when price is absent. One of
rate, price or quote_id must be provided.

face_amount.description:
Bond face amount. Presence-required and must be > 0 (a bare double would
default to a silent zero face).

coupon_rate.description:
Coupon rate. Presence-required (a bare double would default to a silent
zero coupon); may be negative, only a missing or non-finite value is rejected.

redemption.description:
Redemption as a percentage of face. Presence-required and must be > 0
(a bare double would default to a silent zero redemption that destroys
the helper).

price.description: Bond (clean) price; when present, rate is ignored.

quantra_OISHelper.description: OIS helper. Uses IndexRef to reference an overnight IndexDef.

rate.description: OIS rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

overnight_index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id (e.g., "USD_SOFR").

calendar.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT calendar slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (payment-date adjustment on both legs).

fixed_leg_frequency.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT frequency slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (the coupon frequency of both legs unless overridden by QuantLib's
fixed-frequency override, which is not exposed here).

fixed_leg_convention.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT business-day convention slot on the
bootstrapped OIS.

fixed_leg_day_counter.description:
DEPRECATED / accepted-but-unused. No QuantLib OISRateHelper overload
accepts a fixed-leg or payment day counter (the day counts come from the
overnight index and QuantLib's internal fixed-leg default), so this field
is ignored if present and may be omitted. Kept optional for backward
compatibility.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days between accrual end and payment. Required;
must be >= 0. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.payment_lag.

averaging_method.description:
Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Required.
Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.averaging_method.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Required; must be >= 0; 0 = no
lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies — QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback). Name mirrors
OvernightCoupons.lookback_days.

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Required; must be >= 0;
0 = no lockout. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.lockout_days.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Required. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.apply_observation_shift.

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve OIS bootstrapping.

quantra_DatedOISHelper.description: Dated OIS helper with explicit start/end dates.

rate.description: OIS rate. One of rate or quote_id must be provided.

overnight_index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id.

calendar.description:
Required. Despite the generic name, this feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT
calendar slot on the bootstrapped OIS (kept under its historical name
for wire compatibility).

fixed_leg_frequency.description:
Required. Feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT frequency slot on the bootstrapped
OIS (the coupon frequency of both legs unless overridden by QuantLib's
fixed-frequency override, which is not exposed here). Name mirrors
OISHelper.fixed_leg_frequency.

fixed_leg_convention.description:
Required. Despite the fixed-leg name, this feeds QuantLib's PAYMENT
business-day convention slot on the bootstrapped OIS (kept under its
historical name for wire compatibility).

fixed_leg_day_counter.description:
DEPRECATED / accepted-but-unused. No QuantLib OISRateHelper overload
accepts a fixed-leg or payment day counter, so this field is ignored if
present and may be omitted. Kept optional for backward compatibility.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days between accrual end and payment. Required;
must be >= 0. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.payment_lag.

averaging_method.description:
Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Required.
Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.averaging_method.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Required; must be >= 0; 0 = no
lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies — QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback). Name mirrors
OvernightCoupons.lookback_days.

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Required; must be >= 0;
0 = no lockout. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.lockout_days.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Required. Name mirrors OvernightCoupons.apply_observation_shift.

deps.description: Exogenous discount curve for dual-curve OIS bootstrapping.

quantra_ZeroRatePoint.description: Zero rate point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).

date.description: Maturity date for the zero rate (YYYY-MM-DD).

zero_rate.description: Zero rate for this maturity. Required.

compounding.description: Compounding convention for the zero rate.

quantra_DiscountFactorPoint.description:
Discount-factor point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).
Feeds a QuantLib InterpolatedDiscountCurve: the discount factors are
interpolated directly, which differs from interpolating zero rates.

date.description: Maturity date for the discount factor (YYYY-MM-DD).

discount_factor.description:
Discount factor to this maturity. Required; must be in (0, 1]. The first
point (reference date) must carry a discount factor of exactly 1.0.

quantra_ForwardRatePoint.description:
Forward-rate point for direct curve construction (no bootstrapping).
Feeds a QuantLib InterpolatedForwardCurve: the INSTANTANEOUS,
continuously-compounded forward rate f(t) is interpolated directly (this is
the quantity InterpolatedForwardCurve integrates to obtain zero rates and
discount factors — NOT a simple/discrete forward over a period). This
interpolates a DIFFERENT quantity than InterpolatedZero or
InterpolatedDiscount, so off-node values differ for the same market data.

date.description: Node date for the forward rate (YYYY-MM-DD).

forward_rate.description:
Instantaneous, continuously-compounded forward rate at this node.
Required. May be negative in some markets; only non-finite is rejected.

spread.description: Basis spread. One of spread or quote_id must be provided.

quantra_FxSwapHelper.description:
FX swap helper (QuantLib FxSwapRateHelper). Bootstraps the discount curve
of the NON-collateral currency of the pair from FX swap points, given the
spot and the discount curve of the collateral currency: the implied
forward S + points must reprice to S * DF_collateral(T) / DF_other(T) from
the spot date. The curve being bootstrapped is always the other
currency's discount curve; the collateral curve is an exogenous curve the
bootstrapper builds first (dependency ordering), so the two may never be
the same curve.

quote_id.description:
Reference to a shared quote in pricing.quotes (quote_type = Curve: the
points move with rates, so they take part in the curve bump) instead of
an inline fx_points value.

tenor.description: Forward tenor from the spot date (1W, 1M, 3M, ...). Required.

fx_spot.description:
Id of the FxSpotSpec in pricing.fx.spots. Required. The spot supplies
the pair, the spot rate, the spot lag (QuantLib fixingDays), the joint
settlement calendar and the business-day convention of the helper.

end_of_month.description: End-of-month rule for the forward date. Required.

collateral_currency.description:
ISO code of the collateral currency: the currency whose discount curve
is given (collateral_curve). Required; must equal the spot's
base_currency or quote_currency. The curve being bootstrapped is then
the discount curve of the other currency of the pair.

collateral_curve.description:
Discount curve of the collateral currency, by id. Required; must name
another curve of pricing.rates.curves, which is bootstrapped first.

quantra_CrossCcyBasisHelper.description:
Cross-currency basis swap helper (QuantLib
ConstNotionalCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper). Bootstraps the discount
curve of ONE currency of the pair from a constant-notional cross-currency
basis swap: a base-currency floating leg against a quote-currency floating
leg, notional 1 in each currency exchanged at the start and at the end of
the swap, the basis spread added to one of the two legs. The other
currency's discount curve, both legs' forwarding curves and the two indices
are given; the curve being bootstrapped is the discount curve of the leg
whose *_discount_curve reference is absent (the classic use: a EUR curve
for USD-collateralised trades, quote_discount_curve = the USD OIS curve,
base_discount_curve absent).

Constant notional: both notionals stay fixed for the life of the swap, so
the FX spot rate cancels from the par condition and never enters the
bootstrap. The spot is still referenced (fx_spot) because it names the
pair: the two indices must be in its base and quote currencies, and its
spot lag is the swap's settlement lag.

Legs: an IBOR index pays at its own tenor (one fixing per period); an
overnight index pays a compounded coupon every payment_frequency. The
spread_on_base_leg flag, the collateral side and the basis sign follow
QuantLib's convention for the pair (EUR/USD: collateral in USD, basis on
the EUR leg, typically negative).

spread.description:
Basis spread (decimal, -0.0015 = -15 bp) added to the leg selected by
spread_on_base_leg. Exactly one of spread or quote_id must be present.
May be negative.

quote_id.description:
Reference to a shared quote in pricing.quotes (quote_type = Curve: the
basis moves with rates, so it takes part in the curve bump) instead of
an inline spread.

tenor.description: Swap tenor from the settlement (spot) date. Required.

fx_spot.description:
Id of the FxSpotSpec in pricing.fx.spots. Required. The spot names the
pair (base_index must be in its base_currency, quote_index in its
quote_currency) and supplies the settlement lag (spot_days, QuantLib
fixingDays). Its rate does not enter a constant-notional bootstrap; its
settlement calendars and convention are not used either: the swap
schedule follows this helper's own calendar / business_day_convention
/ end_of_month.

base_index.description:
Forwarding index of the base-currency leg (IndexDef id). Required; its
IndexDef.currency must equal the spot's base_currency. IBOR or
overnight (see payment_frequency).

base_forwarding_curve.description:
Forwarding curve of base_index, by id. Required; must name another
curve of pricing.rates.curves (bootstrapped first), never the curve
being bootstrapped: the leg's forwards are projected off this curve
while the curve under construction only discounts.

base_discount_curve.description:
Discount curve of the base-currency leg, by id. Exactly one of
base_discount_curve / quote_discount_curve is given: the given one is
the collateral currency's discount curve (bootstrapped first), the
absent one is the curve being bootstrapped.

quote_index.description:
Forwarding index of the quote-currency leg (IndexDef id). Required; its
IndexDef.currency must equal the spot's quote_currency. IBOR or
overnight (see payment_frequency).

quote_forwarding_curve.description:
Forwarding curve of quote_index, by id. Required; same rules as
base_forwarding_curve. It may be the same curve as the quote leg's
discount curve (a single USD OIS curve both projects and discounts).

quote_discount_curve.description:
Discount curve of the quote-currency leg, by id. See
base_discount_curve.

spread_on_base_leg.description:
true: the basis spread is added to the base-currency leg; false: to
the quote-currency leg. Required.

payment_frequency.description:
Coupon frequency of a compounded overnight leg. Required when
base_index or quote_index is an overnight index (QuantLib builds the
overnight leg as compounded coupons on this schedule); when the other
leg is an IBOR index the value must equal that index's tenor. Must be
absent when both indices are IBOR: each leg then pays at its index
tenor and there is nothing to choose.

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days (helper calendar, Following) applied to
every coupon and to the final notional exchange of both legs. Required;
must be >= 0. The pillar date of the helper is the last payment date,
so a non-zero lag moves it.

calendar.description:
Calendar of the swap schedule (settlement date = valuation date +
spot_days on it, coupon dates, payment lag). Required.

business_day_convention.description: Business-day convention of the swap schedule. Required.

end_of_month.description: End-of-month rule of the swap schedule. Required.

mtm_reset.description:
Mark-to-market (resetting) notionals. Required; must be false in this
version: a resetting-notional swap (QuantLib
MtMCrossCurrencyBasisSwapRateHelper) is not supported yet and is
rejected with 400.

quantra_PointsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single curve point.

bootstrap_trait.description:
Curve family selector. Present ⇒ selects how the curve is built from its
points (Discount/ZeroRate/FwdRate bootstrap from rate helpers;
InterpolatedZero interpolates explicit zero-rate points). Absent ⇒ the
request is rejected — there is no auto-dispatch by point type.

quantra_QuoteMatrix2D.description: 2D quote matrix (n_rows x n_cols). Interpretation depends on caller.

quote_ids.description: Optional, length = values. Empty => inline values.

quantra_QuoteTensor3D.description: 3D quote tensor (n_1 x n_2 x n_3). Interpretation depends on caller.

quote_ids.description: Optional, length = values. Empty => inline values.

quantra_IrVolBaseSpec.description: IR volatility base (Normal, Lognormal, ShiftedLognormal). Supports caps/floors and swaptions.

volatility_type.description:
Quotation convention of the supplied vols. Presence-required: an omitted
type is a 400, never the alphabetical-0 default (Normal), which would
price a lognormal-quoted surface as normal vols.

quantra_BlackVolBaseSpec.description: Equity/FX volatility base (always lognormal, no displacement).

quantra_SwaptionVolAtmMatrixSpec.description: ATM matrix swaption volatility (expiry x tenor).

quantra_SwaptionVolSmileCubeSpec.description: Smile cube swaption volatility (expiry x tenor x strike).

allow_external_atm.description: Require explicit opt-in when client provides atm_forwards.

atm_forwards.description: Optional for Absolute, required for SpreadFromATM.

quantra_SwaptionSabrCalibrateSpec.description:
SABR calibrate swaption volatility.

Strike axis interpretation: `strikes` are spreads from the per-node ATM
forward (rate units, e.g. -0.02 = -200bp). The same spread vector applies
at every (expiry, tenor) node, matching QuantLib's XabrSwaptionVolatilityCube
API. 0.0 spread (true ATM) is not required to be in the grid — per-node ATM
vols are interpolated from the user grid at spread=0.

`vols` is row-major nExp*nTen*nStrikes; values are absolute market vols.

`weights` is rejected in v1 — set `vega_weighted_smile_fit=true` for
vega-weighted fitting instead. Per-strike non-uniform weights are not
exposed by QuantLib 1.41's calibrator.

weights.description: Reserved. Must be empty/absent in v1; otherwise parse-time rejection.

vega_weighted_smile_fit.description:
When true, the SABR calibrator weights residuals by Black vega. This is
the standard "vega-weighted smile fit" QL flag (cube-level, not per
strike).

swap_index_id.description: Required convention anchor for all swaption vol surfaces.

strikes.description: Surface strike axis (required only for shape=SmileCube3D).

term_vols.description: Term vols as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_expiries x 1), row-major.

surface_vols.description: Surface vols as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_expiries x n_strikes), row-major by expiry then strike.

surface_prices.description:
Surface prices as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_price_expiries x n_price_strikes), row-major by expiry then strike.
Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_expiries.description: Absolute expiry dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_strikes.description: Surface strike axis for prices matrix. Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_option_type.description: Option type used for implied-vol inversion from prices. Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

spot.description: Spot level for implied-vol inversion. Optional if spot_quote_id is provided.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve id in pricing.curves used for implied-vol inversion.

use_flat_discount_rate.description: If true and discount_curve_id is empty, use flat_discount_rate.

flat_discount_rate.description: Continuously-compounded flat risk-free rate used when use_flat_discount_rate=true.

dividend_curve_id.description: Dividend yield curve id in pricing.curves used for implied-vol inversion.

use_flat_dividend_rate.description: If true and dividend_curve_id is empty, use flat_dividend_rate.

flat_dividend_rate.description: Continuously-compounded flat dividend yield used when use_flat_dividend_rate=true.

allow_extrapolation.description: Default extrapolation mode for this surface when consumed by pricing endpoints.

surface_interpolator.description:
Interpolation of a strike x expiry surface (see the enum): Bilinear
unless asked; `/calibrate-vol-surface` returns CubicStrikeLinearTime.

expiry_interpolator.description:
Deprecated for BlackVolSpec surfaces; retained for backward compatibility.
Mapping: (Linear,Linear)=>Bilinear, (LogCubic,LogCubic)=>Bicubic.

strike_interpolator.description:
Deprecated for BlackVolSpec surfaces; retained for backward compatibility.
Mapping: (Linear,Linear)=>Bilinear, (LogCubic,LogCubic)=>Bicubic.

quantra_YoYOptionletVolSpec.description:
Constant year-on-year inflation optionlet volatility, referenced by id from
year-on-year inflation cap/floor trades. Currently a single flat vol; a
strike/tenor surface form is a future additive extension (add optional
axis/matrix fields alongside `constant_vol`, mirroring OptionletVolSpec ->
AtmMatrix growth). The surface frequency and index-interpolation flag are
NOT carried here: they are taken at pricing time from the year-on-year
inflation index/curve the trade references, so the vol surface stays
convention-consistent with its index.

constant_vol.description:
Flat lognormal/normal optionlet volatility. Presence-required: an
omitted vol is a 400, never a silent 0.0.

vol_type.description:
Pricing formula / engine selector (Black / UnitDisplacedBlack /
Bachelier). Presence-required.

day_counter.description: Day counter for the vol surface time axis. Presence-required.

calendar.description:
Calendar the vol surface advances the reference date on.
Presence-required.

business_day_convention.description: Business-day convention for the vol surface. Presence-required.

observation_lag.description: Observation lag of the vol surface (e.g. 3 Months).

quantra_SviSlice.description:
One expiry of an `SviVolSpec`: the raw SVI total variance
w(k) = a + b (rho (k - m) + sqrt((k - m)^2 + sigma^2)), k = ln(K / forward)
(Gatheral's raw parameterisation, QuantLib `SviSmileSection`), the Black
vol being sqrt(w(k) / T) with T the base day counter's year fraction from
the reference date to `expiry`. The formula is global in strike: no
strike extrapolation exists or is needed.

expiry.description:
Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), strictly after the reference date; slices
must be strictly increasing.

forward.description: The forward the slice is written against (the origin of k), > 0.

b.description:
b >= 0; the slice must satisfy a + b sigma sqrt(1 - rho^2) >= 0 so the
minimum total variance is not negative.

quantra_SviVolSpec.description:
Black volatility as raw SVI slices (what `/calibrate-vol-surface` with
`SviPerExpiry` returns as `vol_surface_spec_svi`): the smile of every
quoted expiry with its exact curvature, so that a Dupire local vol
derived from it reprices the quotes through a Monte Carlo (the grid of
a `BlackVolSpec` loses that curvature between nodes unless it is
interpolated with `CubicStrikeLinearTime`). Accepted wherever a Black
vol is referenced (`price-equity-option` `volatility`, a structured
note's `underlyings[].volatility_id`); strike-dependent, so a structured
note simulates it as Dupire local vol with `monte_carlo.steps_per_year`.
`base` carries the reference date, calendar, business-day convention and
day counter only: `shape` must be left at its default, `constant_vol` and
`quote_id` absent (400 otherwise).

slices.description: At least one slice, strictly increasing expiries.

allow_extrapolation.description:
Whether an expiry beyond the last slice may be read at all (flat
implied vol); strikes need no flag, the formula is global.

quantra_VolSurfaceSpec.description: Volatility surface specification referenced by id in trade requests.

quantra_ConstantOptionletVolatility.description: Constant optionlet volatility for coupon pricer.

volatility.description:
Constant optionlet volatility. Presence-required (a bare double would
default to a silent zero) and must be finite and non-negative. A genuine
0 is valid: for a coupon leg without caps/floors the Black pricer with
zero vol reproduces the deterministic forward, so 0 is accepted while an
omitted value is rejected.

quantra_BlackIborCouponPricer.description: Black Ibor coupon pricer with optionlet volatility.

quantra_CouponPricer.description: Coupon pricer specification referenced by id.

quantra_QuoteSpec.description: Market quote (spot price, FX rate, etc.). Used by Pricing.quotes[] and helper quote_id references.

value.description:
Quote value. Presence-required (a bare double would default to 0 and
silently bootstrap every referencing helper off a zero rate). May be
negative (rates/spreads); only a missing or non-finite value is rejected.

model_type.description:
Pricing model / engine selector. Presence-required: an omitted type is a
400, never the alphabetical-0 default (Black).

swaption_vol_id.description: Swaption volatility surface id used as calibration target.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve id used by both helper pricing and model dynamics.

forwarding_curve_id.description: Forwarding curve id used to build the floating index in calibration helpers.

swap_index_id.description: Swap index id defining fixed/float leg conventions for calibration helpers.

expiries.description: Optional expiry grid override. If omitted, server falls back to ATM matrix expiries.

tenors.description: Optional tenor grid override. If omitted, server falls back to ATM matrix tenors.

a_init.description:
Initial guess for Hull-White "a". When calibrate_a is true the guess is
clipped into [a_lower, a_upper] before the fit starts.

a_lower.description:
Lower bound on "a" during a joint (calibrate_a = true) calibration.
Below about 1e-3 the Hull-White objective is numerically flat in "a"
and the fitted value is noise; the optimizer is kept out of that region.
Must be > 0 and < a_upper. Ignored when calibrate_a is false.

a_upper.description:
Upper bound on "a" during a joint calibration. Must be > a_lower.
Ignored when calibrate_a is false.

model_type.description:
Swaption pricing model type. Presence-required: an omitted type is a
400, never the alphabetical-0 default (Black).

lattice_steps.description: Number of time steps for TreeSwaptionEngine lattice.

param_mode.description: Parameter source: Explicit values from this model or Calibrate from hw_calibration.

quantra_EquityVanillaModelSpec.description: Equity vanilla option pricing model specification (future).

model_type.description:
Pricing model / engine selector. Presence-required: an omitted type is a
400, never the alphabetical-0 default (BlackScholesAnalytic).

quantra_ModelSpec.description: Model specification referenced by id in trade requests.

quantra_SwapIndexFixedLegSpec.description: Fixed leg conventions for swap index. Every convention is presence-required.

quantra_SwapIndexFloatLegSpec.description:
Floating leg conventions for swap index. Every convention is
presence-required.

quantra_SwapIndexDef.description: Swap index definition for swaption smile conventions.

spot_days.description: Spot/effective-date lag used for exercise-to-swap-start advancement.

calendar.description: Metadata only; pricing uses fixed_leg/float_leg conventions.

business_day_convention.description: Metadata only; pricing uses fixed_leg/float_leg conventions.

end_of_month.description: Metadata only; pricing uses fixed_leg/float_leg conventions.

quote_type.description:
Quote convention (ParSpread / Upfront). Presence-required: an omitted
value is a 400, never the alphabetical-0 default (ParSpread).

running_coupon.description:
Running coupon for upfront quotes (decimal). Optional; presence-driven
(a genuine 0 running coupon is valid for some upfront quotes, an absent
value on an upfront quote is rejected).

quantra_CdsHelperConventions.description:
CDS helper conventions for curve building. Every convention is
presence-required: an omitted value is a 400 naming the field, never a
silent market-default assumption.

quantra_CreditCurveSpec.description: Default probability curve specification for CDS pricing.

quantra_DiscreteDividend.description: Discrete cash dividend for equity underlyings.

quantra_EquityUnderlyingSpec.description: Shared equity underlying specification referenced by option trades.

quantra_EquityBermudanExercise.description: Bermudan exercise with explicit exercise dates.

strike.description: Strike price. Presence-required and must be > 0.
Strike price. Presence-required and must be > 0.

quantra_InflationIndexSpec.description: Inflation index specification. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

observation_lag.description: Observation lag used for swaps (e.g., 3 Months).

interpolated.description:
Whether the index is interpolated between fixings. Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes the observed CPI.

revised.description: Whether index values can be revised (rare). Presence-required.

underlying_zero_index_id.description: For ratio-based YoY indices, link to the underlying zero inflation index id.

fixings.description: Historical CPI/YoY fixings needed for helper-based bootstrap and forecasting.

quote_value.description:
Inline quote value used when quote_id is empty. Presence-required on the
inline path (a bare double would default to a silent zero quote); may be
negative, only a missing or non-finite value is rejected.

swap_observation_lag.description: Lag applied when observing the CPI index in the swap.

start_date.description: Optional explicit start date for dated helper construction.

end_date.description: Optional explicit end/maturity date for dated helper construction.

quote_value.description:
Inline quote value used when quote_id is empty. Presence-required on the
inline path (a bare double would default to a silent zero quote); may be
negative, only a missing or non-finite value is rejected.

nominal_curve_id.description: QuantLib YoY helper requires a nominal term structure id.

quantra_InflationPointWrapper.description: Wrapper for one inflation curve point.

quantra_InflationCurveSpec.description: Inflation term-structure definition, modeled like rates `TermStructure`.

bootstrap_accuracy.description: Numerical bootstrap tolerance (not a market convention): keeps its default.

discount_curve_id.description: Optional discount curve id for inflation-leg projection/discounting models.

quantra_CalendarOverride.description:
Per-request holiday overrides for one calendar. The overrides apply to every
use of that calendar while the request is processed and are discarded
afterwards; nothing is stored on the server.

calendar.description:
Calendar to override (required). Aliases of the same underlying calendar
(e.g. UnitedStates / UnitedStatesSettlement) share their overrides.

added_holidays.description:
Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that must be treated as holidays. A date that is
already a holiday or a weekend is accepted and has no effect.

removed_holidays.description:
Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that must be treated as business days. A date that is
already a business day is accepted and has no effect; weekend dates are
rejected.

quantra_FxSpotSpec.description:
FX spot rate shared by curve helpers and FX products. Referenced by id,
the same way curves and indices are.

The pair is given as two ISO currency codes, never as a six-letter string:
one unit of `base_currency` costs `rate` units of `quote_currency`
(EUR/USD 1.08 = base EUR, quote USD, rate 1.08).

`rate` is the market spot, i.e. the rate for delivery on the spot date
(`spot_days` business days after the valuation date on the joint settlement
calendar). The engine never turns it into an as-of rate implicitly; where an
as-of conversion is needed it is computed from the spot and the two discount
curves, X = S * DF_quote(spot) / DF_base(spot), the same algebra QuantLib's
FxSwapRateHelper uses.

The spot lag and the settlement calendars are per-pair market conventions
(T+2 for most pairs, T+1 for USD/CAD, USD/TRY, ...; both currencies'
calendars, plus the USD calendar for crosses where the market settles
through USD). They are stated by the user on every spot: the engine keeps
no convention table and never infers them from the currency codes.

id.description:
Identifier referenced by FxSwapHelper.fx_spot, CrossCcyBasisHelper.fx_spot
and the FX products (e.g. "EURUSD_SPOT"). Required; unique within
pricing.fx.spots.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the base currency (three uppercase letters). Required.

quote_currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the quote currency (three uppercase letters). Required;
must differ from base_currency.

rate.description:
Spot rate: units of quote_currency per one unit of base_currency, for
delivery on the spot date. Exactly one of rate or quote_id must be
present. Must be finite and strictly positive.

quote_id.description:
Reference to a shared quote in pricing.quotes instead of an inline rate.
The quote must carry quote_type = Fx: curve quotes (quote_type = Curve)
are shifted by the rate bump-and-reprice machinery, and a spot rate
must never move with a parallel rate bump.

spot_days.description:
Spot lag in business days on the joint settlement calendar, from the
valuation date to the spot date. Required; must be >= 0 (2 for most
pairs, 1 for USD/CAD, USD/TRY and a few others, 0 for same-day).

settlement_calendars.description:
Calendars whose holidays all count for spot and forward settlement; the
engine joins them (QuantLib JointCalendar, a holiday in any one is a
holiday of the pair). Required; at least one entry. Typically the two
currencies' calendars, plus the USD calendar for crosses when the
market convention says so.

business_day_convention.description:
Business-day convention applied when a settlement date (spot or forward
maturity) falls on a holiday of the joint calendar. Required.

quantra_FxMarketData.description: FX market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

spots.description: Spot rates referenced by id from curve helpers and FX products.

quantra_CorrelationMatrixSpec.description:
Correlation matrix between the underlyings of a basket product, referenced
by id from the trade (`StructuredNote.correlation_id`). There is no
correlation market: the matrix is an input (historical estimate, dealer
mark) and the engine only validates it. It must be square, symmetric,
with a unit diagonal and every entry in [-1, 1], and positive
semi-definite (a Cholesky factorisation must succeed); otherwise the
request is a 400 naming the first offending pair of labels, or "not
positive semi-definite". No repair is applied to the matrix as supplied;
a bump-and-reprice correlation sensitivity may repair the BUMPED matrix
and says so in the response.

id.description:
Identifier referenced by trades (e.g. "QUAD_INDEX_HIST_2Y"). Required;
unique within pricing.correlations.matrices.

labels.description:
Ids of the underlyings the rows/columns refer to, in matrix order:
`EquityUnderlyingSpec.id` (or `FxSpotSpec.id` for products that
simulate an FX rate). Required; at least two distinct entries. A
trade referencing this matrix must have exactly these underlyings
(any order; the engine permutes), 400 naming the missing or extra
label otherwise.

values.description:
The matrix: n_rows = n_cols = len(labels), values row-major in label
order, inline or via quote_ids into pricing.quotes. Required.

quantra_CorrelationMarketData.description: Correlation market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

matrices.description: Correlation matrices referenced by id from basket products.

quantra_RatesMarketData.description: Rates market data shared across interest-rate products.

indices.description: Index definitions used by floating-rate instruments and curve helpers.

swap_indices.description: Swap index definitions for convention-stable swaption smile ATM computation.

quantra_CreditMarketData.description: Credit market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

quantra_VolatilityMarketData.description: Volatility and model data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

vol_surfaces.description: Volatility surfaces referenced by pricing and sampling endpoints.

models.description: Pricing models/engines referenced by product requests.

quantra_EquityMarketData.description: Equity market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

equity_underlyings.description: Equity underlyings referenced by equity option trades.

quantra_InflationMarketData.description: Inflation market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

bond_pricing_details.description: Include bond analytics (duration, convexity). Used by: FixedRateBond, FloatingRateBond.

bond_pricing_flows.description: Include cash flow details. Used by: FixedRateBond, FloatingRateBond.

swaption_pricing_details.description:
Include analytic swaption greeks (delta/vega/gamma/theta/DV01) from the
Black/Bachelier calculator: rate sensitivities per 1bp (gamma per bp^2),
vega per 1bp of vol, theta per calendar day. Also fills atm_forward,
annuity and implied_volatility. See SwaptionResponse field comments.

swaption_pricing_rebump.description:
Include bump-and-reprice swaption analytics: dv01 and gamma from a +/-1bp
parallel curve bump, vega from a +/-1bp vol bump, theta from a 1-calendar-
day clean market roll (evaluation date AND every explicit reference_date
move one day; date-anchored points and fixings stay). Same units as the
analytic greeks. When both flags are set the rebump dv01/gamma/vega/theta
overwrite the analytic ones; delta, atm_forward and annuity are only
produced by swaption_pricing_details. Greeks not computed are absent.

quantra_Pricing.description: Central pricing configuration grouped by market-data domain.

settlement_date.description: Settlement date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used by: FixedRateBond, FloatingRateBond.

quotes.description: Shared market quotes (spot prices, FX rates, helper quotes).

calendar_overrides.description:
Per-request holiday overrides (optional). Applied to every use of the
named calendars in this request. Used by: ALL.

fx.description:
FX spot rates referenced by FX-implied curve helpers (FxSwapHelper,
CrossCcyBasisHelper) and FX products. Optional.

correlations.description:
Correlation matrices between basket underlyings, referenced by id
from basket products (`StructuredNote.correlation_id`). Optional;
validated (symmetric, unit diagonal, |rho| <= 1, positive
semi-definite) on every request that carries the block, whether or
not a product references a matrix. Used by: structured notes.

quantra_FixedCoupons.description:
Fixed-rate coupons: `notional x rate x accrual` per period of the leg's
`schedule` with the leg's `day_counter`, paid on the leg's payment
conventions (`SwapLeg`). The `FixedCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`:
the fixed leg of `price-vanilla-swap`, `price-ois-swap`, a swaption
underlying and either `price-cross-currency-swap` leg. (Named
`SwapFixedLeg` before 0.9.0; before 0.10.0 the coupon table carried the
schedule, notional and conventions that now live on the leg.)

rate.description: Annual coupon rate as a decimal (0.032 = 3.20%). May be negative.

quantra_IborCoupons.description:
IBOR floating coupons: one fixing of `index` per period of the leg's
`schedule` (`fixing_days` before the accrual start, or at the accrual end
with `in_arrears`), coupon `notional x (fixing + spread) x accrual` with
the leg's `day_counter`. The `IborCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`:
the floating leg of `price-vanilla-swap` and a swaption underlying, both
`price-basis-swap` legs, a `price-cross-currency-swap` leg. The index
must be an IBOR index: an overnight index here is a 400 naming
`OvernightCoupons`. (Named `SwapFloatingLeg` before 0.9.0.)

index.description: Reference to an IBOR IndexDef by id (e.g., "EUR_6M"). Required.

spread.description:
Additive spread over the index fixing, as a decimal (0.0005 = 5 bp).
Keeps a literal 0.0 default: zero is the market-standard value.

fixing_days.description:
Fixing lag in business days before each accrual start. Absent = the
index's own `IndexDef.fixing_days` (QuantLib's default for an IBOR
leg); present => this value overrides it for the leg. Must be >= 0.
Not read for a swaption underlying, which always fixes on the index's
own fixing days.

in_arrears.description:
When true the coupon fixes at the end of its accrual period (no
convexity adjustment is priced: the zero-volatility pricer reads the
shifted fixing). Rejected (400) on a swaption underlying.

yield_curve_model.description: Yield-curve model used by Hagan-family pricers.

mean_reversion.description: Mean reversion parameter used by TSR/Hagan-family pricers.

hagan_hard_upper_limit.description:
Numeric Hagan hard upper integration limit.
If <= 0.0, QuantLib default hard upper limit is used.

quantra_CmsCoupons.description:
Constant-maturity swap-rate coupons. Coupon formula per period of the
leg's `schedule`: `notional x accrual x (gear x CMSRate + spread)` with
the leg's `day_counter`, optionally capped and floored. The `CmsCoupons`
member of `SwapLeg.coupons`: the floating leg of `price-vanilla-swap` (a
CMS swap is a vanilla swap whose floating leg carries CMS coupons).
Rejected (400) on `price-ois-swap`, `price-basis-swap`,
`price-cross-currency-swap` and a swaption underlying; a CMS leg takes no
`payment_calendar` / `payment_lag` (400 when present). (Named
`SwapCmsLeg` before 0.9.0.)

swap_index_id.description: Swap index conventions id from Pricing.swap_indices (e.g. "EUR_SWAP_6M").

swap_tenor.description: Constant maturity tenor for CMS fixing (e.g. 10Y).

swaption_vol_id.description: Swaption volatility surface id from Pricing.vol_surfaces used by CMS pricer.

fixing_days.description: Optional fixing days override; if negative, uses swap index spot_days.

pricer.description:
Optional CMS coupon pricer configuration.
If null, defaults are used (LinearTsr with mean_reversion=0.03).

cap.description:
Optional cap strike. Present => every CMS coupon is capped at this rate
(produces CappedFlooredCmsCoupons). Absent => uncapped.

floor.description:
Optional floor strike. Present => every CMS coupon is floored at this rate.
Absent => unfloored. If both cap and floor are present, cap must be >= floor.

quantra_OvernightCoupons.description:
Overnight floating coupons: the daily fixings of an overnight `index`
compounded (or averaged) over each period of the leg's `schedule`, paid
with the leg's `payment_convention` / `payment_calendar` / `payment_lag`,
with the lookback / lockout / observation-shift conventions of the
market. The coupons take the index's own day counter (the leg's
`day_counter` is accepted but not read, as QuantLib's OvernightIndexedSwap
does). The `OvernightCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`: the overnight
leg of `price-ois-swap` and a swaption underlying, a `price-basis-swap`
leg, a `price-cross-currency-swap` leg (all built by the same code). The
index must be an overnight index: an IBOR index here is a 400 naming
`IborCoupons`. (Named `OisFloatingLeg` before 0.9.0; before 0.10.0 it
carried the payment calendar and lag that now live on the leg.)

index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id (e.g., "USD_SOFR"). Required.

spread.description:
Spread over the compounded/averaged overnight rate. Keeps a literal 0.0
default on purpose: zero is the genuine market-standard value, not a
convention that could silently diverge.

averaging_method.description: Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Presence-required.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Presence-required; must be >= 0; 0 =
no lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies; QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback).

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Presence-required; must be
>= 0; 0 = no lockout.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Presence-required.

telescopic_value_dates.description:
Performance toggle for QuantLib's telescopic value-dates optimization,
not a market convention; keeps a literal false default on purpose.

quantra_SwapLegFlow.description:
One cash flow of a swap leg (`SwapLegResult.flows` and the zero-coupon /
inflation swap flow lists).

accrual_year_fraction.description: Accrual year fraction used by the coupon.

gearing.description: Coupon gearing multiplier (1.0 for fixed coupons).

fixing_date.description: Floating leg metadata. For overnight coupons this may not represent the compounded effective coupon rate.

index_fixing.description: Underlying index fixing. For CMS coupons this is the CMS swap-rate fixing.

cms_swap_rate.description: CMS swap-rate fixing for a CMS coupon. Absent for non-CMS coupons.

rate.description: Coupon rate: fixed-leg rate or effective floating coupon rate.

kind.description:
Kind of flow. Set on every flow of a `SwapLeg` result
(`SwapLegResult.flows`, every swap endpoint), whose lists mix coupons
and notional exchanges (a NotionalExchange flow has `payment_date`,
`amount`, `discount`, `present_value` and `kind` only). Absent on the
zero-coupon and inflation swap endpoints, whose flows are all coupons.

quantra_SwapLeg.description:
One leg of a swap: a coupon stream in one currency, discounted on its own
curve, with its own principal exchanges, paid or received by the party
whose NPV is reported. The fields every coupon kind shares (notional,
schedule, day count, payment conventions) live on the leg, as in the
FpML / ORE leg model; `coupons` holds only what is specific to the kind.
This is the leg model of every swap endpoint:
`VanillaSwap`, `OisSwap`, `BasisSwap` (one currency, no spot) and
`CrossCurrencySwap` (two currencies) are each two `SwapLeg`s under
role-named fields, and a swaption underlying is a `VanillaSwap` or an
`OisSwap` made of them.

Principal exchanges follow the leg: the party that RECEIVES the leg's
coupons PAYS the leg's notional on the schedule's start date (initial
exchange) and RECEIVES it with the last coupon (final exchange). In the
leg's own frame the flows are therefore coupons +, initial exchange
-notional, final exchange +notional; `pay_receive` then applies the side:
the payer of the coupons receives the initial exchange and pays the final
one.

pay_receive.description:
Whether the reported party pays (`Pay`) or receives (`Receive`) this
leg's coupons. Presence-required; the two legs of a swap must take
opposite values (400 otherwise). Replaces the pre-0.10.0 `swap_type`
(Payer = pay the fixed leg / leg1).

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the leg's currency (three uppercase letters). A
floating leg's index must carry the same `IndexDef.currency` (400
otherwise). The two legs of a vanilla, OIS or basis swap must be in
one currency, the two legs of a cross-currency swap in two. Required.

notional.description:
Constant notional of the coupons and of the principal exchanges.
Presence-required and must be > 0 unless the per-period `notionals`
vector is supplied (then optional). A bare double would default to a
silent zero notional.

notionals.description:
Optional per-period notionals, one entry per coupon period in schedule
order, each > 0. Present => amortizing / step-up leg (overrides
`notional` for the coupons; the first entry is the exchanged
notional); absent => constant `notional`. Accepted on the legs of
`price-vanilla-swap`; rejected (400) on `price-ois-swap`,
`price-basis-swap`, `price-cross-currency-swap` and a swaption
underlying.

schedule.description: Accrual schedule of the coupons. Required.

day_counter.description:
Accrual day count of the coupons. Presence-required with
`FixedCoupons`, `IborCoupons` and `CmsCoupons`; accepted but not read
with `OvernightCoupons` (the overnight index's day counter applies, as
in QuantLib's OvernightIndexedSwap).

payment_convention.description:
Business-day convention applied to the payment dates.
Presence-required. Not read for a swaption underlying, whose
QuantLib::VanillaSwap / OvernightIndexedSwap adjusts both legs with
the floating schedule's convention.

payment_calendar.description:
Calendar the payment dates are adjusted (and lagged) on. Absent = the
schedule's calendar. Presence-required on both legs of
`price-ois-swap` (an OIS pays with the overnight calendar and lag);
optional elsewhere; rejected with `CmsCoupons` (400 when present).

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days (on `payment_calendar`) between each
accrual end and its payment. Absent = 0: pay on the adjusted accrual
end. Presence-required on both legs of `price-ois-swap` (QuantLib's
OvernightIndexedSwap applies one lag to both legs; the leg model makes
it a per-leg convention); optional elsewhere; rejected with
`CmsCoupons` (400 when present). Must be >= 0.

coupons.description:
What the leg pays each period (see `SwapCoupons`): the kind-specific
fields only (rate; index, spread, fixing...). Required; the tag
`coupons_type` is required with it.

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the curve in `pricing.rates.curves` that discounts every flow of
this leg (coupons and exchanges). For a collateralised cross-currency
trade, the currency's collateral-adjusted curve. A swaption underlying
needs one discount curve: both of its legs must name the same id.
Required.

forwarding_curve.description:
Id of the curve in `pricing.rates.curves` the floating index projects
off (for `CmsCoupons`, the curve the swap index's IBOR leg projects
off). Required with `IborCoupons` / `OvernightCoupons` / `CmsCoupons`
(400 when missing), rejected with `FixedCoupons` (400 when present: a
fixed leg projects nothing).

initial_exchange.description:
Whether the leg's notional is exchanged on its schedule's start date
(paid by the receiver of the leg's coupons). Presence-required on
`price-cross-currency-swap`; on the single-currency endpoints absent =
false (an explicit `true` is priced: the exchange becomes a
NotionalExchange flow of the leg). Rejected when true on a swaption
underlying.

final_exchange.description:
Whether the leg's notional is exchanged on the last coupon's payment
date (received by the receiver of the leg's coupons). Same presence
rule as `initial_exchange`.

quantra_SwapLegResult.description: Result of one swap leg (`legs` of a swap response, request order).

npv.description:
Present value of the leg (coupons and exchanges) in the leg's own
currency, signed from the reported party's view: the leg's own-frame
value (as the receiver of its coupons sees it) times -1 when the party
pays the leg (`Pay`) and +1 when it receives it (`Receive`). A paid leg
is therefore negative only when it is worth paying for: paying a 2.55%
fixed leg (with its exchanges) on a 3% curve is in the payer's favour
and positive. The swap's `npv` is the sum of its legs' values.

npv_reporting.description:
`npv` converted to the swap's reporting currency at the as-of exchange
rate. Equal to `npv` on a single-currency swap (vanilla, OIS, basis),
whose reporting currency is the legs' currency.

flows.description:
Future flows of the leg in payment order (`include_flows` only), in
the leg's own frame: coupon amounts positive, the initial exchange
-notional, the final exchange +notional; `kind` tells them apart. The
sum of their `present_value`s is `npv / s` (s = -1 for `Pay`, +1 for
`Receive`). For an overnight coupon `rate` is the compounded rate (plus
spread) and `index_fixing` the fixing on the coupon's first fixing
date; for a CMS coupon `index_fixing` and `cms_swap_rate` are the CMS
swap-rate fixing.

quantra_CrossCurrencySwap.description:
Cross-currency swap: two `SwapLeg`s in two different currencies (400 when
equal: two legs in one currency are a vanilla, OIS or basis swap), each
with its own discounting (and forwarding) curve and its own principal
exchanges, one paid and one received (`SwapLeg.pay_receive`; 400 when
both legs take the same side). Any combination of coupon kinds is allowed
(fixed/float, float/float, fixed/fixed). Priced as two QuantLib legs
(coupons plus `SimpleCashFlow` exchanges), each NPV'd on its own curve and
converted to the reporting currency at the as-of exchange rate implied by
the FX spot and the two discount curves (see `CrossCurrencySwapResponse`).

leg2.description: Second leg, in the other currency. Required. Reported as `legs[1]`.

quantra_PriceCrossCurrencySwap.description:
One cross-currency swap together with the FX spot that converts between
its two currencies and the currency its total NPV is reported in. The
legs name their own discounting and forwarding curves (`SwapLeg`); every
reference is by id into `pricing`.

fx_spot.description:
Id of the `FxSpotSpec` in `pricing.fx.spots`. Its base and quote
currencies must be the two leg currencies, in either order (either leg
may be the base-currency leg; the pair is never inverted). The spot
and the two legs' discounting curves give the as-of exchange rate
X = S * DF_quote(t_s) / DF_base(t_s). Required.

reporting_currency.description:
Currency of the reported `npv`: `leg1.currency` or `leg2.currency`
(400 for any other value; reporting in a third currency is not
supported). Required.

quantra_PriceCrossCurrencySwapRequest.description: Request to price one or more cross-currency swaps against one market.

include_flows.description:
When true every response row lists each leg's future flows (coupons
and notional exchanges) in payment order.
